meta.learning: Each evening appends one entry to day_notes (date, correct_of_5, note) — what the day taught, so the method improves day by day. The page shows the whole story day-wise.

pick_fields.assessment: one-line evening assessment: did the call work, and did the actual move match the expected entry/exit pattern (filled in the evening)
pick_fields.correct: true if the close moved in the predicted direction vs the open (filled in the evening)
pick_fields.expected_move: how the price is expected to move for entry/exit — morning forecast, e.g. 'gap up 3-5% at open, hold; enter at open, exit near close' (filled in the morning; starts Thu 26 Nov 2026 — Wed 25 Nov picks have none)
pick_fields.gap_pct: (open - prev close)/prev close*100 (filled in the evening)
pick_fields.open_0915: price at 09:15 open (filled in the evening)
pick_fields.story_id: story id from that morning's shortlist file

meta.scoring: HYBRID + SENTIMENT-BASED + SUBJECTIVE (Shiva, 2026-11-24): hard rules filter to a shortlist, then the morning agent reads each story and scores sentiment by judgment, -2 to +2, not by a formula
meta.strategy: Overnight-news intraday paper test (Nifty 500; news 16:00 last trading day -> 08:30 next trading day). 5 picks a day from Thu 26 Nov 2026 (Shiva, 25 Nov), each with reason + expected entry/exit move; evening assessment after market, day-wise.
